description: 경찰청_포털기관 습득물정보 조회 서비스 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경찰청. 경찰청 범죄예방정책과에서 제공하는 포털기관 습득물정보 조회 서비스는 경찰청 산하 기관 외 지하철, 공항, 쇼핑몰, 놀이공원 등 다양한 포털기관에서 보관 중인 습득물 정보를 통합적으로. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 경찰청. Its tags are 포털기관습득물정보조회, 경찰, 습득물, 포털기관, 분류별검색. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-05-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
